_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py. The two cost figures carry different scopes and are never combined.

units.basis: modular gas generators El Paso Electric proposes to buy

bridge_years_max.basis: the proposed bridge period, an upper bound

total_cost_musd.basis: the judges' proposed finding, generation facilities only

cost_incl_tx_musd.basis: the estimate including transmission interconnection and AFUDC, as the City's witness gave it

hearing_parties.basis: the parties listed as appearing through counsel, counted

bridge_share_of_life.basis: drawn as the bridge's length against the service life's length at one scale, never printed

plant_share_of_peak.basis: drawn as the plant's length against the committed peak at one scale, never printed

units_times_rating_kw.basis: a consistency check on the record, never printed
